subject: MedEdge DPA: redlines, evidence pack and signature choreography
messages:
From: Alex Carter <acarter@mededgehealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@mededgehealth.com>, Lisa Nguyen <lisa.nguyen@mededgehealth.com>
Date: 2028-03-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: DPA and evidence pack for MedEdge onboarding

Hi Jonas —

Thanks for the demo this morning. We had a few follow-ups from procurement and legal. Two asks to get us to contracting: 1) our legal team needs a DPA redline returned with suggested signature routing (exec + legal + procurement), and 2) SOC 2 / SIG / CAIQ evidence or pointers we can share internally so the security team can close their review.

Scope notes: MedEdge will be processing patient-identifiable data for a pilot in the US and EU markets — we may need SCCs and HIPAA coverage confirmation. Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II and the SIG-Lite spreadsheet (or CAIQ export)?

Timeline: procurement has asked for an executed DPA by 2028-04-05 to meet our onboarding window. Let us know the earliest you can return a clean redline.

Attachments: MedEdge_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx (we'll send the completed SIG-Lite answers this afternoon)

Thanks,
Alex Carter
Director of Procurement
MedEdge Health
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Alex Carter <acarter@mededgehealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-21T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DPA and evidence pack for MedEdge onboarding

Alex —

Appreciate the clear asks. Short answer: yes, we can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II and a CAIQ export; we can also accept SCCs and support HIPAA scoping.

Plan of action from our side:
- I will coordinate a DPA redline and routing recommendation.
- Lauren (legal ops) will consolidate our suggested clause language for SCCs and retention carveouts.
- We'll produce a minimal evidence pack: SOC 2 redacted PDF, SIG-Lite template filled by our security team, and the CAIQ JSON export.

Requested from you: please confirm the signer list (names/emails and which signatory has final exec authority) and whether MedEdge requires a separate Data Processing Addendum or prefers an integrated DPA as an amendment to the Master Services Agreement.

Target for our first redline: 2028-03-24 EOD. If you need the DocuSign envelope sooner, flag and we'll expedite.

Jonas Weber
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Alex Carter <acarter@mededgehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-22T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DPA and evidence pack for MedEdge onboarding

Hi all —

Looping in the legal ops and signature team. A couple of notes as we prepare the redline:

1) SCCs / international transfers: We can provide the EU Commission standard contractual clauses as an addendum if MedEdge requires them. If personal data processing will be under an EU controller instruction, we'll need to confirm data residency controls and subprocessors (list + countries).

2) HIPAA: For US PHI, Redwood offers a BAA / HIPAA addendum. We need confirmation on whether MedEdge will push PHI processing to production for the pilot or if the pilot uses de-identified flows. That will determine if the BAA needs to be signed now.

3) Evidence pack contents (what we'll attach to the response):
   - SOC 2 Type II (redacted): control mappings and attestation (PDF)
   - SIG-Lite completed workbook: control responses (XLSX)
   - CAIQ export (JSON): architecture and control alignment
   - DPIA checklist (if required): short questionnaire

4) Signature choreography: propose a single DocuSign envelope with multiple recipients in this order: MedEdge legal signatory (Lisa Nguyen) -> MedEdge exec (final authority) -> Redwood legal (Irene Choi) -> Redwood exec (Jonas or delegated exec). We can adjust if MedEdge needs procurement in the loop.

I've attached an initial DPA_Redline_v1.docx with tracked comments for your review.

Lauren Bishop
Senior Manager, Legal Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: DPA_Redline_v1.docx (tracked)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Carter <acarter@mededgehealth.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-24T16:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DPA and evidence pack for MedEdge onboarding

Alex / team —

Thanks — Jonas and Lauren, thanks for the initial redline. I've reviewed and will coordinate the signing lane. A couple of operational checks before we send the DocuSign:

- Signer identities: please confirm full names and emails for the MedEdge legal and exec signers. Lisa Nguyen was copied above; we need her formal signatory line.
- Evidence delivery: we will share the SOC2 redacted PDF and CAIQ export via a secure Drive link; SIG-Lite workbook can go directly in the DocuSign package for the security review.
- Retention/escrow: MedEdge asked about retention windows for audit logs. Proposed retention: 12 months rolling by default, with extended retention options available on request (we flagged as a negotiable commercial term).

DocuSign plan:
- Envelope 1 (DPA): recipient 1: Lisa Nguyen (MedEdge legal) — CAN SIGN; recipient 2: MedEdge exec (CAN SIGN); recipient 3: Irene Choi (Redwood legal) — NEEDS TO SIGN; recipient 4: Jonas Weber (Redwood exec) — FINAL SIGN.
- Expected turn-around: 48 hours after envelope sent, assuming MedEdge signers are available.

If MedEdge will require SCCs + BAA both executed, we recommend two linked envelopes to avoid mixing EU and HIPAA-specific statements in the same document. Happy to discuss.

Marissa Cole
Head of Contracts & Customer Success Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none (DPA_Redline_v2 to follow)
From: Alex Carter <acarter@mededgehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@mededgehealth.com>, Lisa Nguyen <lisa.nguyen@mededgehealth.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-28T15:06:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DPA and evidence pack for MedEdge onboarding

Marissa / Jonas —

Good plan, thank you. Confirming:
- Signers: Lisa Nguyen (lisa.nguyen@mededgehealth.com) as legal, and CEO Mark Dawes (mark.dawes@mededgehealth.com) as exec final signatory. Procurement will remain copied but will not be a signatory.
- Scope: we will need SCCs included (we have EU pilot users) and a linked BAA for HIPAA. Two-envelope approach is fine.
- Evidence: attached are our completed SIG-Lite and CAIQ answers (files). Please send the SOC2 redacted PDF and your CAIQ export; we will treat the SOC2 as confidential and will redact internally.

Expedite request: procurement has asked to close signature by 2028-04-03 if possible. Can you get the DPA envelope out by 2028-03-30? If not, let us know and we will adjust the go-live.

Thanks — we'll watch for DPA_Redline_v2 and the evidence links.

Alex Carter
Director of Procurement
MedEdge Health

Attachments: MedEdge_SIG-Lite_completed.xlsx, MedEdge_CAIQ_answers.json
